title: ImportExcel Agentic AI Flow Map
moduleScope: AI-assisted reporting layer added to ImportExcel. This layer profiles tabular files, plans reports from prompts, renders workbooks with ImportExcel, and can generate reusable PowerShell automation scripts.

entryPoints.name: Get-ExcelDatasetSummary
entryPoints.purpose: Turns CSV, TSV, or workbook sources into compact metadata for planning and prompts.

entryPoints.name: New-ExcelReportPlan
entryPoints.purpose: Builds a constrained JSON-compatible report plan using PSAISuite or the deterministic fallback.

entryPoints.name: Invoke-ExcelReportPlan
entryPoints.purpose: Executes a report plan into an .xlsx workbook with tables, charts, pivots, summaries, and analysis sheets.

entryPoints.name: Invoke-ExcelPrompt
entryPoints.purpose: End-to-end path for prompt to workbook: profile, plan, render.

entryPoints.name: New-ExcelReportScript
entryPoints.purpose: Creates reusable PowerShell automation from a prompt, with validation and deterministic fallback.

entryPoints.name: Invoke-ExcelAgent
entryPoints.purpose: Generates a reusable script and optionally runs it to create the workbook.

flows.title: 1. Dataset Profiling
flows.summary: Reads tabular sources and produces the compact facts every other flow depends on.
flows.whenToUse: Use this first when inspecting source shape, preparing AI context, or building a deterministic report plan.
steps: Resolve the source path.
Load one or more sources from CSV, TSV, or Excel worksheets.
Infer column type and role: Dimension, Measure, Time, or Boolean.
Capture row count, column count, column names, sample rows, missing values, distinct values, and suggested number formats.

flows.title: 2. Prompt to Report Plan
flows.summary: Converts a dataset summary and natural-language prompt into an executable report plan.
flows.whenToUse: Use when you want to inspect, save, or edit the plan before building the workbook.
steps: Build the deterministic default plan first.
If -NoAI is supplied, return the deterministic plan.
Otherwise ask PSAISuite to return constrained JSON only.
Parse and validate the model response.
Apply deterministic prompt intent defaults for analysis sheets, chart type, and formatting.
outputs: Report plan object with Tables, Charts, Pivots, ConditionalFormats, AnalysisSheets, and Summary
flows.fallback: If the AI call or JSON parsing fails and -FallbackToDefault is supplied, the deterministic plan is returned.
flows.example:
$summary = Get-ExcelDatasetSummary .\sales.csv
$plan = New-ExcelReportPlan -DatasetSummary $summary -Prompt "Create a report with data bars and a line chart" -NoAI

flows.title: 3. Report Plan to Workbook
flows.summary: Executes a plan into a real Excel workbook using ImportExcel primitives.
flows.whenToUse: Use when you already have a plan object or JSON plan and want a workbook artifact.
steps: Write source data sheets first as real Excel tables.
Apply table style, filters, freeze panes, autosize, and number formats.
Create charts from plan definitions.
Add analysis sheets such as Executive Dashboard, Statistical Analysis, and Correlation Matrix.
Add summary and column profile sheets at the end of the workbook.
Open the workbook again to add pivots and conditional formatting safely.
outputs: Result object with Path, SourcePath, Plan, DatasetSummary, and worksheet names
flows.layoutRule: User-facing data appears first, pivots and analysis follow, and Summary plus Column Profile stay at the end.

flows.title: 4. End-to-End Prompt Workflow
flows.summary: The shortest path from data and prompt to workbook.
flows.whenToUse: Use for normal report generation when you do not need to inspect the intermediate plan.
steps: Profile the dataset with Get-ExcelDatasetSummary.
Create the plan with New-ExcelReportPlan.
Render the workbook with Invoke-ExcelReportPlan.
outputs: Same render result returned by Invoke-ExcelReportPlan
flows.example: Invoke-ExcelPrompt -Path .\sales.csv -Prompt "Create an executive dashboard with a pie chart" -OutputPath .\sales-report.xlsx -FallbackToDefault -Show

flows.title: 5. Prompt to Reusable Script
flows.summary: Creates a reusable PowerShell script that can rebuild the workbook later.
flows.whenToUse: Use when the user wants automation they can inspect, rerun, edit, or ship.
steps: Profile the dataset.
Build a deterministic fallback script from dataset facts and prompt intents.
If AI is enabled, ask PSAISuite for a complete ImportExcel-based PowerShell script.
Strip markdown fences and parse-check the generated script.
Validate command names, parameter names, aliases, missing required arguments for non-switch parameters, and disallowed direct EPPlus styling calls.
Write the selected script to ScriptPath.
outputs: Result object with ScriptPath, WorkbookPath, SourcePath, UsedAI, Model, Script, and DatasetSummary
flows.fallback: If AI generation, parsing, or command validation fails and -FallbackToDefault is supplied, the deterministic script is saved instead.
flows.example: New-ExcelReportScript -Path .\sales.csv -Prompt "Create the data in a table and use data bars" -OutputPath .\sales-agent-report.xlsx -ScriptPath .\build-sales-agent-report.ps1 -FallbackToDefault

flows.title: 6. Agent Workflow
flows.summary: Generates a reusable script and optionally runs it to produce the workbook.
flows.whenToUse: Use for the agentic workflow: the workbook is created and the automation script is kept as an artifact.
inputs: -ScriptOnly when the script should be generated but not run
steps: Call New-ExcelReportScript.
If -ScriptOnly is not supplied, execute the generated script.
If the AI-generated script fails at runtime and -FallbackToDefault is supplied, regenerate the deterministic script and run it.
Return workbook and script metadata.
outputs: Result object with Path, ScriptPath, SourcePath, UsedAI, Model, ScriptOnly, and Result
flows.fallback: Runtime fallback protects the demo and user workflow when model-written code passes static validation but still fails.
flows.example: Invoke-ExcelAgent -Path .\sales.csv -Prompt "Create the data in a table, use data bars, highlight top 3, and create a line chart" -OutputPath .\sales-agent-report.xlsx -ScriptPath .\build-sales-agent-report.ps1 -FallbackToDefault -Show

supportingSystems.name: Prompt Intent Defaults
supportingSystems.description: Deterministic helpers interpret high-value phrases like pie chart, line chart, data bars, color scale, top N, bottom N, executive dashboard, and data scientist analysis.

supportingSystems.name: Deterministic Fallback
supportingSystems.description: Every AI-dependent flow builds a local fallback first, so offline demos and failed model calls can still produce useful workbooks.

supportingSystems.name: Script Guardrails
supportingSystems.description: Generated scripts are parse-checked and validated against available PowerShell commands and parameters before being saved or executed.

supportingSystems.name: PSAISuite Bridge
supportingSystems.description: AI calls are routed through PSAISuite, resolved from an explicit path, environment variable, sibling repository, or PSModulePath.

supportingSystems.name: Workbook Layout Policy
supportingSystems.description: Data sheets come first, pivots and analysis follow, and profile or summary material is placed at the end.

promptIntents.effect: Selects the chart type in deterministic plans and fallback scripts.
Adds DataBar, ThreeColorScale, Top, or Bottom rules to the primary measure column.
Adds Executive Dashboard, Statistical Analysis, and Correlation Matrix sheets where appropriate.

exampleScripts.flow: Inspect the summary and plan before rendering
Profile an existing workbook and render a new report
Agent workflow that keeps and runs a reusable script

futureFlows.name: Deterministic Insight Engine
futureFlows.description: Add functions like Get-ExcelInsight, Get-ExcelOutlier, Get-ExcelCorrelation, Get-ExcelTrend, and Get-ExcelSegmentBreakdown so AI can rank and narrate grounded facts.

futureFlows.name: Workbook Editing Agent
futureFlows.description: Open existing .xlsx files, inspect sheets, propose repairs or enhancements, and apply targeted edits with audit-friendly steps.
